title: Grateful Dead Live at Curtis Hixon Convention Hall on 1973-12-18
source: 3 source matrix: Soundboard (shnid 97511); AdamG's audience recording (new flat transfer); and Dan McDonald's audience recording (new flat transfer)

ai_review.summary: High‑quality matrix capture of a vibrant show highlighted by a stellar Space > Eyes sequence.
ai_review.review: Listeners praise this release as a superbly preserved performance, noting the powerful Space into Eyes segue and an overall lively set. The recording is widely regarded as clear and enjoyable—though a few hear it more like an audience tape, the consensus is that the matrix sound is solid and pleasant to listen to.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers give 4‑5 stars and commend both the musical performance and the listening quality; only one modest 3‑star comment raises a source‑type question, so overall rating is strong.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Generally praised as clear and well‑preserved; a few listeners think it sounds more like an audience recording, but the consensus is that the matrix mix is solid with no major issues.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Smooth transition highlighted by a strong Space into Eyes pairing; overall set feels lively and cohesive.
